Synopsis:
The Hag is about to perform her eye-extraction and replanting on you. She is in her hag form in all its disgusting glory. Initially she's happy and feeling powerful -- but when she finds out your tadpole is Netherese, she becomes angry; not quite frightened, but anxious about having that magic in her home. She wants you out and has no more patience for you.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAG_Hag_Transformed.json: The scene takes place in the hag’s lair (the hag is in full monstrous form and is about to perform a brutal eye‑extraction/replanting on the player), and she’s enjoying the power and spectacle of the moment. Off‑screen there may already have been earlier beats in the lair — fights around cages, illusions, and prior dealings involving the hagspawn Mayrina and the hag’s bargains — which shape tense attitudes but aren’t shown in this node. The player is known to host a tadpole, and when the hag learns the parasite is Netherese in origin (ancient, dangerous magic) she shifts from smug delight to alarmed anger; she’s not outright terrified but becomes anxious about that magic in her home and loses patience. The provided lines reflect her theatrical cruelty as she prepares the operation, followed by a brusque desire to get the player out once the tadpole’s nature is revealed.
- HAG_Hagspawn_StartScene.json: This is the main hag dialogue. In it, you can ask about Mayrina (who is present) or make a deal to have your parasite removed. If you keep asking about Mayrina (twice), the hag will be furious and vanish Mayrina away while she deals with the 'busybody' - the player.If you agree to the tadpole deal, you must give up an eye (in the transformed dialogue).
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_TransformedHag.json: The continuation of the LOW_BlushingMermaid_DisguisedHag dialogue when the hag drops her disgusie. Hag can offer the player
- HAG_MurderousFrog_AD_Frog.json: This is a frog in the hag's swamp. When the hag is not defeated she is fighting the hag's control - hissing and ribbiting in pain as she struggles not to hurt anyone.When the hag is defeated, she is cheerfully ribbiting as she hops about the swamp.In the top two nodes, she is showing the player a stash of loot as a reward for freeing her from the hag. Only available with SwA.
- HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim1.json: A victim of the hag, forced to wear a mask that takes away her free will so that she fights for and serves the hag. If the hag is killed, this character regains her senses and resolve. She's deeply shaken by her experience, but courageous, telling the player that she'll inform the people of Baldur's Gate of our heroism, and vowing to hunt down the hag's accomplices in the city.

context: You're in the hag's lair; the hag has dropped her human disguise and revels in her monstrous form as she prepares to extract and replant one of your eyes. Off-screen there have already been tense beats—fights around cages, illusions, and dealings involving her hagspawn Mayrina and prior bargains—that shape the dangerous atmosphere and Mayrina's presence. The player is known to host a tadpole, and when the hag learns the parasite is Netherese in origin she shifts from smug delight to alarmed anger, anxious about that ancient magic being in her home and eager to get you out. The hag is theatrical and cruel, willing to make a bargain (removal at the cost of an eye) but losing patience once she realizes the tadpole's true nature.
